case_number: 2025 INSC 439; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.1759 OF 2025 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Criminal) No.6053 of 2021)
summary: Appeal against refusal to quash summoning order; sanction under Section 197 CrPC & Section 170 Karnataka Police Act not required as alleged acts exceeded official duty; assault causing grievous hurt during custodial treatment; delay in filing complaint explained by complainant's efforts to obtain sanction; protection under immunity provisions unavailable for non-official acts; D. Devaraja precedent distinguished; abatement for deceased accused.
legal_provisions_cited: D. Devaraja vs. Owais Sabeer Hussain, (2020) 7 SCC 695
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside.
